id: title:gantoine:give the jest and semgrep jobs a longer budget in a copy of the repository

review.posthog_relevance: Changes GitHub Actions workflow timeout configurations for PostHog-specific repositories, potentially allowing longer execution times on slower runners to prevent flaky failures.
review.reason: The observed changes are narrowly scoped to GitHub Actions workflow configuration, specifically adjusting timeout values for PostHog repositories while maintaining standard values for others. This represents a maintenance and operational improvement rather than a substantive code or capability change. No tier 2 or 3 evidence exists.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of these configuration changes is not demonstrated by the code; the score relies on the assumption that longer timeouts prevent failures, which is a conjecture not verified by the implementation. No tier 2 or 3 evidence exists.

observations.behavior: Replaces a fixed 20-minute timeout with a conditional expression: 20 minutes if the repository is PostHog/posthog, otherwise 30 minutes.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the CI frontend workflow to run longer on a slower GitHub-hosted runner pool while keeping the standard 20-minute budget for other repositories, potentially preventing flaky failures or timeouts on the slower infrastructure.
